sections.title: Release readiness
sections.sql: select code,heading,status,linked_tests,current_passes from v_verification order by code

sections.title: Needs attention
sections.sql: select * from v_attention order by code,finding

sections.title: Verification coverage
sections.sql: select code,heading,linked_tests,current_passes,latest_failures,stale_results from v_verification order by code

sections.title: Suspect links
sections.sql: select * from v_suspect_links order by from_code,to_code

sections.title: Review queue
sections.sql: select code,heading,owner,due_on,status from items where status in ('draft','review') order by due_on nulls last,code
